name: Dead-lettering
short_description: Dead-lettering is a messaging safety net that parks events or messages that cannot be delivered in a separate store, so they can be inspected and replayed later instead of being dropped.

evidence.quote: When delivery fails. Retries and dead lettering.
If the message keeps failing, it eventually gets moved to the dead letter queue.
Dead lettering is your safety net.
parks the run in a dead letter queue with full context for human remediation
